snippet.title: Front Page - Trailer
snippet.description:
Front Page is a Narrative game about freedom of speech and free will.

As Editor of an independent newspaper, you are in charge of printing daily front pages. You decide which story you want to publish, and see the world change depending on your choices and actions. What kind of Editor will you become?

⭐ Wishlist now on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4075840/Front_Page/
